items.caption: This Shang-style oracle-script form has a human-like figure beneath a marked head. Paleographic analyses interpret the upper mark as the head and relate it to head or top-of-head uses of 天; the form does not settle whether “head” or “sky” was the word’s earlier meaning.
items.alt: Black glyph with a long horizontal stroke above a human-like figure whose lower strokes spread apart.
items.selection_reason: The legible form illustrates the head-marked human-figure analysis discussed in the entry, while the cited accounts preserve the unresolved relationship between that interpretation and 天’s sky meaning.

limitations.text: The head-marked interpretation and reported head-related uses do not establish a single earliest spoken meaning or a certain sequence from head or top to sky or heaven; another account treats “sky” as the original meaning.
The image is a modern redraw of an oracle-script exemplar. Its specific exemplar has no independently established absolute date in the cited evidence.
